access.notes: Open-source DFT code; includes pw.x, ph.x, and epw.x.
Available from pseudopotential libraries (e.g., PseudoDojo) or generated with the ONCVPSP code. Nb 4s²4p⁶4d³5s², Se 4s²4p⁴ valence configurations.
Maximally localized Wannier functions; needed by EPW.
Included in the Quantum ESPRESSO distribution (epw.x).

Lattice parameters a = 3.444 Å, c = 12.550 Å, space group P6₃/mmc (no. 194). Atomic positions are relaxed internally as described in the paper. Well-known bulk structure; can be built from literature data.
